name: Dots
tagline: Turns a floor plan into a tactile-style map with a QR code that answers wayfinding questions by text or voice.

awards: Track: Agentverse - Search & Discovery of Agents

problem: Floor plans are everywhere but give blind and low-vision visitors almost no usable orientation.
solution: Gemini generates a high-contrast tactile-style map and a compliance summary from a floor plan; each map gets a QR link where ASI:One answers text questions and an ElevenLabs agent answers by voice, grounded in that map only.
demo_moment: Team-described: upload a stadium plan, print the tactile map, scan the QR and ask where the exits are.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Track: Catalyst For Care” and “Track: Agentverse - Search & Discovery of Agents” among 307 submissions.
Makes a physical accessibility artifact conversational through a QR code.
Won a care track and the Agentverse prize with one product.

lessons: A QR code can turn a static accessibility artifact into a conversation.
